label: GhostKey - Estado Dispositivo v1

label: GhostKey - Comandos Pendientes HTTP v3
info: Ciclo robusto de comandos: pending -> delivered -> executed/failed. Reentrega delivered. ACK de set_state actualiza device_state real.

label: GhostKey - Eventos Universales v2 + Gotify

label: GhostKey - Reporte Telemetría v3 + Command Sync
info: POST /api/devices/report: actualiza snapshot, guarda telemetría y entrega/reentrega un comando pending/delivered dentro de la misma respuesta.

name: Validar activación
Activar dispositivo
query:
WITH claimed AS (
    SELECT
        cc.id AS claim_id,
        cc.claimed_device_id AS device_id,
        d.user_id
    FROM ghostkey_v2.claim_codes cc
    JOIN ghostkey_v2.devices d
        ON d.id = cc.claimed_device_id
    WHERE cc.code = $1::text
      AND cc.status = 'used'
      AND cc.claimed_device_id IS NOT NULL
      AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
    LIMIT 1
),

ghost_user AS (
    SELECT
        u.id AS ghost_user_id,
        u.email
    FROM ghostkey_v2.users u
    WHERE u.id = (
        SELECT user_id
        FROM claimed
    )
    LIMIT 1
),

traccar_user AS (
    SELECT
        tu.id AS traccar_user_id
    FROM tc_users tu
    WHERE LOWER(tu.email) = LOWER(
        (
            SELECT email
            FROM ghost_user
        )
    )
    LIMIT 1
),

existing_traccar AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM tc_devices
    WHERE uniqueid = $2::text
    LIMIT 1
),

created_traccar AS (
    INSERT INTO tc_devices (
        name,
        uniqueid,
        disabled
    )
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT d.name
                FROM ghostkey_v2.devices d
                WHERE d.id = (
                    SELECT device_id
                    FROM claimed
                )
            ),
            $1::text
        ),
        $2::text,
        FALSE
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM claimed
    )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM existing_traccar
    )
    RETURNING id
),

resolved_traccar AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM existing_traccar

    UNION ALL

    SELECT id
    FROM created_traccar

    LIMIT 1
),

link_user_device AS (
    INSERT INTO tc_user_device (
        userid,
        deviceid
    )
    SELECT
        tu.traccar_user_id,
        rt.id
    FROM traccar_user tu
    CROSS JOIN resolved_traccar rt
    WHERE tu.traccar_user_id IS NOT NULL
      AND rt.id IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    RETURNING userid, deviceid
),

upd_claim AS (
    UPDATE ghostkey_v2.claim_codes cc
    SET device_unique_id = $2::text
    FROM claimed c
    WHERE cc.id = c.claim_id
    RETURNING cc.claimed_device_id
),

upd_device AS (
    UPDATE ghostkey_v2.devices d
    SET
        traccar_device_id = (
            SELECT id
            FROM resolved_traccar
        ),
        device_state = 'DISARMED',
        last_state_change = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE d.id = (
        SELECT device_id
        FROM claimed
    )
    RETURNING
        d.id,
        d.unique_id,
        d.name,
        d.device_state,
        d.traccar_device_id,
        d.user_id
)

SELECT
    ud.id,
    ud.unique_id,
    ud.name,
    ud.device_state,
    ud.traccar_device_id,
    ud.user_id,
    (
        SELECT traccar_user_id
        FROM traccar_user
    ) AS traccar_user_id
FROM upd_device ud;

WITH expired AS (
 UPDATE ghostkey_v2.device_commands
 SET status='expired'
 WHERE device_id=$1::bigint
   AND command_type='set_config'
   AND status IN ('pending','delivered')
),
snapshot AS (
 SELECT json_object_agg(
   config_key,
   CASE
     WHEN value_type IN ('int','number') THEN to_json(config_value::int)
     WHEN value_type='float' THEN to_json(config_value::double precision)
     WHEN value_type='boolean' THEN to_json(config_value::boolean)
     ELSE to_json(config_value)
   END
 ) AS payload
 FROM ghostkey_v2.device_config
 WHERE device_id=$1::bigint
),
inserted AS (
 INSERT INTO ghostkey_v2.device_commands
 (device_id,command_type,command_payload,status,priority,created_by,expires_at,created_at)
 SELECT $1::bigint,'set_config',snapshot.payload::json,'pending',5,$2::bigint,NOW()+INTERVAL '24 hours',NOW()
 FROM snapshot
 WHERE snapshot.payload IS NOT NULL
 RETURNING id,command_payload,status,created_at,expires_at
)

name: Respuesta estado
Error 500
Preparar GET
Entregar / reentregar comando
query:
WITH candidate AS (
    SELECT dc.id
    FROM ghostkey_v2.device_commands dc
    JOIN ghostkey_v2.devices d
        ON d.id = dc.device_id
    LEFT JOIN ghostkey_v2.claim_codes cc
        ON cc.claimed_device_id = d.id
    WHERE (
           d.unique_id = $1::text
        OR cc.device_unique_id = $1::text
    )
      AND dc.status IN ('pending','delivered')
      AND (
          dc.expires_at IS NULL
          OR dc.expires_at > NOW()
      )
    ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN dc.status = 'pending' THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END,
        dc.priority DESC,
        dc.created_at ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
delivered AS (
    UPDATE ghostkey_v2.device_commands dc
    SET
        status = CASE
            WHEN dc.status = 'pending' THEN 'delivered'
            ELSE dc.status
        END,
        delivered_at = CASE
            WHEN dc.status = 'pending'
                THEN COALESCE(dc.delivered_at, NOW())
            ELSE dc.delivered_at
        END,
        sent_at = CASE
            WHEN dc.status = 'pending'
                THEN COALESCE(dc.sent_at, NOW())
            ELSE dc.sent_at
        END
    FROM candidate c
    WHERE dc.id = c.id
    RETURNING
        dc.id,
        dc.command_type,
        dc.command_payload,
        dc.priority,
        dc.status,
        dc.delivered_at,
        dc.created_at
)
SELECT *
FROM delivered;

name: Respuesta comando
Preparar ACK
ACK + sincronizar estado real
query:
WITH target AS (
    SELECT
        dc.id,
        dc.device_id,
        dc.command_type,
        dc.command_payload
    FROM ghostkey_v2.device_commands dc
    JOIN ghostkey_v2.devices d
        ON d.id = dc.device_id
    LEFT JOIN ghostkey_v2.claim_codes cc
        ON cc.claimed_device_id = d.id
    WHERE dc.id = $1::bigint
      AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND (
             d.unique_id = $2::text
          OR cc.device_unique_id = $2::text
      )
    LIMIT 1
),
updated_command AS (
    UPDATE ghostkey_v2.device_commands dc
    SET
        status = $3::varchar,

        delivered_at = CASE
            WHEN $3::text IN ('delivered','executed','failed')
                THEN COALESCE(dc.delivered_at, NOW())
            ELSE dc.delivered_at
        END,

        executed_at = CASE
            WHEN $3::text IN ('executed','failed')
                THEN NOW()
            ELSE dc.executed_at
        END,

        acked_at = CASE
            WHEN $3::text IN ('executed','failed')
                THEN NOW()
            ELSE dc.acked_at
        END,

        failed_reason = CASE
            WHEN $3::text = 'failed'
             AND $4::text IS NOT NULL
                THEN COALESCE(
                    ($4::json ->> 'reason'),
                    dc.failed_reason
                )
            ELSE dc.failed_reason
        END,

        result = CASE
            WHEN $4::text IS NOT NULL
                THEN $4::json
            ELSE dc.result
        END

    FROM target t
    WHERE dc.id = t.id

    RETURNING
        dc.id,
        dc.device_id,
        dc.command_type,
        dc.command_payload,
        dc.status,
        dc.delivered_at,
        dc.executed_at,
        dc.acked_at,
        dc.result
),
updated_device AS (
    UPDATE ghostkey_v2.devices d
    SET
        device_state =
            (uc.command_payload ->> 'state'),

        last_state_change = NOW(),

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM updated_command uc

    WHERE d.id = uc.device_id
      AND uc.command_type = 'set_state'
      AND uc.status = 'executed'
      AND (uc.command_payload ->> 'state') IN (
          'WAREHOUSE',
          'DISARMED',
          'ARMED',
          'INACTIVE'
      )

    RETURNING
        d.id,
        d.device_state,
        d.desired_state,
        d.last_state_change
)

SELECT
    uc.id,
    uc.command_type,
    uc.status,
    uc.delivered_at,
    uc.executed_at,
    uc.acked_at,
    uc.result,

    COALESCE(
        ud.device_state,
        NULL
    ) AS actual_state,

    COALESCE(
        ud.desired_state,
        NULL
    ) AS desired_state,

    ud.last_state_change

FROM updated_command uc
LEFT JOIN updated_device ud
    ON ud.id = uc.device_id;

SELECT

    ed.device_type,
    ed.event_code,
    ed.name,
    ed.description,
    ed.category,
    ed.default_severity,
    ed.user_visible,

    p.id AS policy_id,
    p.provider,
    COALESCE(p.enabled, FALSE) AS notify_enabled,
    p.priority,
    p.cooldown_s,
    p.title_template,

FROM ghostkey_v2.event_definitions ed

  AND (
       ed.device_type = $1::varchar
    OR ed.device_type IS NULL
  )

ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN ed.device_type = $1::varchar THEN 0
        ELSE 1
    END

LIMIT 1;

name: Preparar búsqueda de comando
Entregar comando en reporte
query:
WITH candidate AS (

    SELECT
        dc.id

    FROM ghostkey_v2.device_commands dc

    WHERE dc.device_id = $1::bigint
      AND dc.status IN (
          'pending',
          'delivered'
      )
      AND (
          dc.expires_at IS NULL
          OR dc.expires_at > NOW()
      )

    ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN dc.status = 'pending'
                THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END,
        dc.priority DESC,
        dc.created_at ASC

    LIMIT 1
),

delivered AS (

    UPDATE ghostkey_v2.device_commands dc

    SET
        status = CASE
            WHEN dc.status = 'pending'
                THEN 'delivered'
            ELSE dc.status
        END,

        delivered_at = CASE
            WHEN dc.status = 'pending'
                THEN COALESCE(
                    dc.delivered_at,
                    NOW()
                )
            ELSE dc.delivered_at
        END,

        sent_at = CASE
            WHEN dc.status = 'pending'
                THEN COALESCE(
                    dc.sent_at,
                    NOW()
                )
            ELSE dc.sent_at
        END

    FROM candidate c

    WHERE dc.id = c.id

    RETURNING
        dc.id,
        dc.command_type,
        dc.command_payload,
        dc.priority,
        dc.status,
        dc.delivered_at,
        dc.expires_at
)

SELECT
    d.id,
    d.command_type,
    d.command_payload,
    d.priority,
    d.status,
    d.delivered_at,
    d.expires_at

FROM delivered d;
